model.clock: n equals the number of vertices
model.fixed_observable: D_i(n) is the degree of one fixed labeled vertex
model.update: vertex n+1 attaches to old v with probability d_v(n)/(2(n-1))

nonclaims: No finite computation is presented as an asymptotic proof.
No theorem about maximum degree or a joint hub law is asserted.
No result for a self-loop seed, the LCD convention, or m greater than one is asserted.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, target divisor, functional equation, zero match, or Hilbert--Polya operator is asserted.

fixed-vertex degree-limit lineage with convention audit

theorem_contract.evidence_boundary: finite exact enumeration is regression evidence only
theorem_contract.excluded: no maximum-degree, joint-hub, m>1, self-loop, or uniform-in-k theorem
theorem_contract.fixed_limit: D_i(n)/sqrt(n) converges almost surely and in every finite Lp
theorem_contract.fixed_moments: all integer rising-factorial orders with the s_i birth-time split
theorem_contract.limit_moments: r! Gamma(s_i-1)/Gamma(s_i-1+r/2), moment determinate by Carleman
theorem_contract.population_limit: for fixed k, N_k(n)/n converges in L2 to 4/[k(k+1)(k+2)]
